text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel can indicate structural or unconscious bias, but on its own, it does not prove sex discrimination. The appointed candidate had relevant credentials and specific international project experience that may have aligned closely with the role's brief. 

First, politely follow up on your request for written feedback. Concurrently, check your ministry's recruitment guidelines to see if diverse interview panels are formally mandated. If the panel breached explicit diversity rules, or if the eventual feedback relies on subjective generalities rather than merit-based criteria, you have valid grounds to challenge procedural fairness. However, raising discrimination before receiving objective scoring and feedback would be premature and could harm your professional standing.
